description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, handling overlay permissions, overlay display control, and user preferences related to overlay features. It manages UI components and interacts with system settings to control overlay permissions and services.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages overlay permission requests, overlay service control, and user preferences for overlay behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores preferences, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect current permission state when activity resumes.

methods.name: updatePermissionStateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI elements to show current overlay permission status.

methods.name: updateOverlayRunning
methods.description: Updates the UI to indicate whether the overlay is running.

methods.name: canDrawOverlays
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to draw overlays. Uses different logic based on Android version.

methods.name: openOverlayPermissionSettings
methods.description: Opens system settings to grant overlay permission.

methods.name: startOverlayService
methods.description: Starts the overlay service, passing parameters based on user preferences.
